title: auditor finding
description: One confirmed finding in the shared finding schema every audit in the library emits. The eleven required fields are the cross-audit contract enforced by scripts/check-prompts.mjs; audits add their own fields on top (cvss, harm_chain, class, wcag, ...).

id.description: Stable finding ID, unique within the run (e.g. SEC-001, I2-004).

audit.description: The audit key that produced the finding (security, repo, frontend, ...). Filled by the orchestrator when it merges runs.

agent.description: The specialist agent within the audit.

evidence.description: The concrete artifact: file:line, request/response, config value, metric. Real secrets and PII are redacted, never copied.

locations.description: Optional explicit code locations. When absent, exporters parse `path:line` tokens out of `evidence`.

standard.description: The technical reference violated (OWASP, CWE, MITRE, WCAG SC, RFC, CIS ...).

controls.description: Certification control IDs from CONTROL-CROSSWALK.md. An empty array is a valid, honest answer.

deal_blocker.description: True when the finding, as it stands, would fail a SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audit, block enterprise procurement, or breach a statutory duty.

fine_exposure.description: One value from the fine-exposure vocabulary in CONTROL-CROSSWALK.md, or "none".

issue_url.description: The tracker issue created for this finding, once it exists.
